title: Ultra High Definition Television — Image Parameter Values for Program Production
scope: 1.1 This standard defines a family of progressive image sample structures of 3840 x 2160 or 7680 x 4320 with an aspect ratio of 16x9, called Ultra High Definition Television (UHDTV), as defined in Table 1. This standard specifies:  RʹGʹBʹ color encoding and digital representation  YʹCʹBCʹR color encoding and digital representation. 1.2 This standard specifies multiple samples, line and frame rate formats for ten-bit and twelve-bit systems. It is not necessary for an implementation to support all formats to be compliant with this standard. However, an implementation must state which of the Systems are supported.
